name: Worried Wife (CR 4)
body:
Worried Wife
CR 4

Source Pathfinder #2.

Type universal
Notice Perception DC 20 (to hear a woman’s voice whisper, “Lorey”—this was the name of Vorel’s and Kasanda’s daughter) hp 8
Trigger proximity; Reset automatic (24 hours)

EFFECT

spell effect (suggestion to drag another PC out of the house (to area B1 if playing Pathfinder #2, likely into the gathering mass of carrionstorms); Will DC 14 resists; CL 8th)
